text:
elaine: quick sync — customers keep asking for per-route cost visibility + low-latency tracing hooks. we need a concrete roadmap and launch gates for Q3. thoughts?
raj: agree. biggest tradeoff is sampling vs storage cost. customers want 100% visibility for hot routes but that balloons retention.
nora: can we do tiered visibility? e.g., full traces for top 1% latency routes, aggregated histograms for others.
sam: +1. also need a clear acceptance criteria doc. propose: dashboards + trace link from error tile, cost breakdown by route, and sampling knobs per-customer.
kevin: actionable metrics to gate on:
- end-to-end trace link from UI within 200ms
- cost delta <= 15% of baseline telemetry spend for default retention
- error-investigation time < 30m for common pages (measured in canary)
elaine: concrete. add canary rules: 2x internal customers (prod-like) + 3 external early-access customers. canary length 2 weeks.
raj: sampling config idea:
```
tracing:
  default_sample_rate: 0.01
  hotpath_rules:
    - route: /v1/generate
      sample_rate: 0.8
    - route: /v1/embeddings
      sample_rate: 0.2
```
This reduces sys load while giving hot-route fidelity.
nora: for dashboards we should include: cost per 1M tokens by route, avg latency p50/p95/p99, traced errors with stack snippet, and tokenized cost projection for next 30 days.
sam: question: retention tiers? default 7d raw traces, 90d aggregates, 30d hot traces for paid tiers? that aligns with Dedicated customers.
kevin: important: surface estimated cost impact in UI before enabling longer retention. customers should see "Estimated extra $X/month".
elaine: launch criteria draft:
- feature parity: trace <-> error navigation from console
- dashboard: per-route cost + latency + error rate
- telemetry budget warning UI + opt-in retention extension
- canary completed with no regressions in latency SLOs
- docs + quickstart for customer engineers
raj: regression checks: ensure per-token p99 latency increase < 10% when tracing enabled. add test harness simulating 10k rps.
sam: UX ask: default view should highlight "cost hotspots" and give one-click drilldown to traces. avoid dumping raw traces by default.
kevin: ops note: storage & ingest budget needs a bucketed billing system. otherwise finance will hate us. estimate: extra ingest ~ 0.5–1.5% of infra spend for 7d default, depends on sample rates.
elaine: ok owners: product (elaine) spec doc, eng-runtime (raj) tracing hooks and sampling infra, eng-platform (kevin) dashboard + cost calc, devex (nora) docs + quickstart, sam for UX.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-start for observability-lanes at 2024-09-05T10:00:00Z
elaine: next steps — raj to drop a draft spec by EOD Wed, kevin to run a balloon-cost estimate by Fri, nora to draft minimal dashboard widgets by Mon. any blockers?
raj: none from infra side, might need a small schema change to trace metadata. i'll call it out in spec.
sam: i'll mock the hotspot widget tonight and share a prototype link.
kevin: ping finance for pre-approval on storage bucket budget.
elaine: thanks all — pushing this into the roadmap doc after raj's spec.
